releaseGate: Release only after localStorage migration and backup recovery are smoke-tested on a copy of real Jarvis user data.
delivery: GitHub stable release -> in-app Frissítés egy kattintással
dataMigration: One-time non-destructive migration from jarvis_entity_* localStorage records to versioned Electron JSON storage.
rollback: v0.5.0 installer plus pre-update Jarvis backup and retained legacy localStorage data
securityBoundary: Entity names are path-sanitized; renderer has CRUD access only through isolated preload IPC and receives no direct filesystem access.
